newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices slip on French poll results.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices slip on French poll results.

text.p: Danish bond prices slipped on Monday after the French left's election victory but dealers said that the result had become priced in over the past week and further losses were likely to be limited.
"Initially prices will go down a little, but nothing drastic," a dealer said.
At 0700 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.10 point from Friday's close, at 110.28, yielding 6.42 percent, while the seven percent 2007 was 0.11 down at 102.90.
The crown was unchanged at 3.8080 per mark.
The 2006 benchmark's 10-year yield gap with Germany widened on basis point from Friday's 47 bp and the 2007-bund differential narrowed one basis point to 66 bp.
